description: A shell script used for testing the 'remerge-diff' functionality in a Git repository. It sets up various merge scenarios, including conflicts, non-content conflicts, filters, and reversions, then verifies the output of 'git show --remerge-diff' and related commands across different states and options.

methods.name: test_write_lines
methods.description: Writes specified lines to a file, used for setting up test data.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with provided commands.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that the given command must fail.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Checks that the output of a command is empty.
